name: numerical: The Amazon e-commerce data science team fits a model…

request.questionText: The Amazon e-commerce data science team fits a model to gain understanding of the extent to which having an Amazon Prime membership leads customers to buy more from the platform than customers without a Prime membership. The data set includes two variables: total Sales revenue for a customer account and a dummy variable representing whether the customer had a Prime membership (0 = no, 1 = yes). The fitted model equation is: What is the predicted sales revenue for a customer who is a Prime member? Round your answer to the nearest dollar.
